title: Sparkly watering can
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- body of watering can -->
    <rect x='30' y='44' width='38' height='32' rx='8' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
    <rect x='33' y='47' width='32' height='26' rx='6' fill='#81d4fa'/>
    <!-- top rim -->
    <rect x='28' y='40' width='42' height='9' rx='4.5' fill='#29b6f6'/>
    <rect x='30' y='41' width='38' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b3e5fc'/>
    <!-- handle -->
    <path d='M34 42 Q34 24 50 24 Q66 24 66 42' fill='none' stroke='#0288d1' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M34 42 Q34 24 50 24 Q66 24 66 42' fill='none' stroke='#4fc3f7' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- spout -->
    <path d='M30 60 L12 42 L16 38 L34 54 Z' fill='#29b6f6'/>
    <path d='M30 58 L14 42 L16 40 L32 54 Z' fill='#81d4fa'/>
    <!-- spout head / rose -->
    <ellipse cx='13' cy='40' rx='8' ry='6' transform='rotate(-45 13 40)' fill='#0288d1'/>
    <ellipse cx='13' cy='40' rx='6' ry='4' transform='rotate(-45 13 40)' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
    <!-- little holes on rose -->
    <circle cx='11' cy='38' r='1.3' fill='#e1f5fe'/>
    <circle cx='15' cy='38' r='1.3' fill='#e1f5fe'/>
    <circle cx='13' cy='42' r='1.3' fill='#e1f5fe'/>
    <circle cx='11' cy='43' r='1.3' fill='#e1f5fe'/>
    <circle cx='16' cy='42' r='1.3' fill='#e1f5fe'/>
    <!-- base highlight -->
    <rect x='38' y='70' width='22' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b3e5fc'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff176'>
    <path d='M78 24 l2 6 6 2 -6 2 -2 6 -2 -6 -6 -2 6 -2 Z'/>
    <path d='M22 18 l1.5 4.5 4.5 1.5 -4.5 1.5 -1.5 4.5 -1.5 -4.5 -4.5 -1.5 4.5 -1.5 Z'/>
    <path d='M80 62 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2 Z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#b3e5fc'>
    <circle cx='60' cy='14' r='2.5'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='46' r='2.5'/>
    <circle cx='46' cy='86' r='2.5'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <path d='M18 72 l1 3 3 1 -3 1 -1 3 -1 -3 -3 -1 3 -1 Z'/>
    <path d='M86 78 l1 3 3 1 -3 1 -1 3 -1 -3 -3 -1 3 -1 Z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
